propositions: Long-running LLM gate operations (transition with completion-verification, review-plan, verify-completion) emit no progress signals to stdout/stderr between start and final verdict, causing supervisor stall watchdogs with 600s budgets to kill healthy runs.

Gate operation execution contains multiple phases (material assembly, store hydration, overlap corpus retrieval) totaling 27-85+ seconds of wall-clock silence even at DEBUG log level, because these phases have no instrumentation at any level.

An agent orchestrating rebar was killed mid-epic-close by its harness after the close operation succeeded but emitted nothing for 600+ seconds, leaving the epic and story stranded in-progress while all descendants remained closed.

The documented design (ADR 0089) defers a streaming/async watchdog for gate operations, but neither codes nor documents a periodic liveness emitter for blocking sync execution, creating a gap between agent requirements and gate behavior.
Gate operations are the mandatory close path per AGENTS.md, so failure occurs at the terminal step of autonomous runs where state loss and invested work are maximal.
